objective: Remove the GCS adapter's memory buffering/5 MB ceiling and wire it on the runtime path.
acceptance_criteria: The GCS adapter streams/resumes large uploads (resumable upload for objects > 5 MB) instead of buffering the whole payload in memory, and validates the declared size.
buildObjectStore() in go/edpsvc/main.go selects the GCS adapter via PF_OBJECT_BACKEND (config-only) with a real auth/token implementation, so the adapter is exercised end-to-end on the runtime path.
A gated real-provider (creds) qualification run is documented and reproducible, so the GCS adapter can be marked production-qualified (mock conformance is not sufficient).
approach: GCS ObjectStore adapter: streaming/resumable upload + wire buildObjectStore (production-qualification)
